from io import StringIO
import textfsm
template=chr(10).join(['Value List ITEM ((?P<name>\\w+):(?P<num>\\d+))', 'Value Required END (\\w+)', '', 'Start', '  ^item ${ITEM}', '  ^end ${END} -> Record'])+chr(10)
fsm=textfsm.TextFSM(StringIO(template))
